title: Ashbury Rewards Points Sharing: Giving Points to Another Member
content:
A member may give points from their own Ashbury Rewards account to another Ashbury Rewards member; giving away points is the sender's own decision, made by the sender personally. A member who asks to give another member the largest transfer their account allows gives it in one transfer.

## Conditions of the result

- The largest transfer is worked out only after the points balance carries a relocation compensation transaction for every relocated reservation attached to the membership.
- The largest transfer is not worked out until every cancelled or no-show Reward Night Rate reservation attached to the membership carries an award redeposit transaction naming its redemption.
- The transfer allowance is set only once the account carries a night-credit transaction for every checked-out Reward Night Rate stay attached to the membership.

## Conditions of every transfer

- Points are transferred without a fee, and a completed transfer is irrevocable when the tier's setting makes transfers irrevocable.
- Both accounts must be active, and the sender must hold at least the points transferred.
- Both accounts must have been open for the tier's minimum number of days since enrolment before a transfer.
- A transfer may not exceed the sender's remaining transfer allowance, and the recipient's receipts in the calendar year, counted with the points received by transfer in the calendar year and including this transfer, may not exceed the annual transfer-in cap of the recipient's tier.
- A sender makes at most one transfer to the same recipient on one calendar day.
- The recipient's arrival transaction mirrors the sender's transfer and names it.

## Capability

`give_points_to_member_c374aed0` is the member's own transfer: the member gives points from their own Ashbury Rewards account to another member's account. One call records the giver's transfer transaction of source `points_transfer` naming the receiving membership and the receiver's arrival transaction mirroring it, both dated today, takes the points off the giver's points balance and adds them to the receiver's. The transfer is final and visible at once in both accounts' activity and balances.

## Invocation

This is a customer-side tool: the customer themselves runs it. The agent unlocks it for the customer with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `give_points_to_member_c374aed0`, and the customer then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the giver's own Ashbury Rewards membership, as read out by the agent from the membership lookup | Identifier |
| `counterparty_member_id` | Reference number of the receiving member's Ashbury Rewards membership, as read out by the agent from the membership lookup of the member number the giver named | Identifier |
| `points` | Points given, as stated by the agent | Whole number of points, always positive; integer, no decimals, no thousands separators |

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the giver's transfer transaction), `arrival_transaction_id` (reference number of the receiver's arrival transaction), `loyalty_member_id` (giver's membership), `counterparty_member_id` (receiver's membership), `receiver_name` (full name on the receiving member's profile), `points` (integer points given), `posted_date` (transfer date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (the giver's points balance once the points are taken off). A returned `transaction_id` means the transfer is complete.
